_comment: Single source of truth for LLM model pricing (per 1M tokens). Consumed by observability.mjs and shared-constants.sh get_model_pricing(). Update this file when model pricing changes.
_format: Each key is a substring matched against model IDs. Values: input, output, cache_read, cache_write (all per 1M tokens in USD).
_openai_source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing?latest-pricing=standard — o3/o3-pro/o3-mini standard rates verified 2026-10-01; cache-write is an estimate where not listed. GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna verified 2026-09-05; GPT-6 Sol/Luna and GPT-5.6 Terra re-verified 2026-09-27; GPT-6.1 Sol added and GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra re-verified 2026-09-30. GPT-5.6 Sol promotional pricing is available at least through 2026-11-21. Other entries were not revalidated in this refresh.
_anthropic_source: Claude Opus 4.5-5.5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5 and Fable 5/5.1 entries come from the OpenCode models.dev catalog snapshot checked 2026-09-27. They were not revalidated against Anthropic's pricing page. Sonnet 5.5 comes from Anthropic's launch announcement (anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-5-5, 2026-09-28); its cache read was corrected to $0.10 (0.05x input) from Anthropic's pricing page on 2026-10-07. Haiku 5.5 (released 2026-10-07) comes from Anthropic's pricing page and model overview (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/haiku-5-5/overview): the entry is the prompts-up-to-100K tier; prompts over 100,000 tokens cost 5x ($0.50 in, $2.50 out, $0.05 cache read, $0.625 cache write), which this flat table does not model. Keys match as ordered substrings, so specific IDs (for example opus-5-5-fast, opus-5-5, opus-4-8) must stay before generic family keys (opus-4, sonnet-4, haiku-4).
_estimate_scope: The refreshed OpenAI rates are Standard short-context API-equivalent estimates, not invoices or ChatGPT subscription allowance percentages. Long-context rates, Fast mode, regional uplifts and subscription capacity are not modelled by this flat table.
